TEXT.about_description:
The KHL channel — Russia's first sports TV channel dedicated exclusively to one sport, ice hockey.
News, relevant interviews, the most striking goals, fantastic goalkeeping saves and power techniques: all this is just a small part of what a fan can see on the air.
